def mat_mul(A, B):
    C = [[0]*4 for _ in range(4)]
    for i in range(4):
        for j in range(4):
            C[i][j] = sum(A[i][k]*B[k][j] for k in range(4))
    return C

    ca, sa = math.cos(alpha), math.sin(alpha)
    ct, st = math.cos(theta), math.sin(theta)
    return [

        [st*ca, ct*ca, -sa, -d*sa],

Specimen S-26 spring rate: **13.95 N/mm**.

I pressed the platen on centre with the tared force probe and fitted Fz against encoder tip height over 0.4–47 N. The slope was linear (R² ≈ 1): k_fit = 12.75 N/mm, contact at z = 95.57 mm. The probe axis is vertical, so the steady Fx/Fz ≈ 0.78 was treated as cross-talk and not added into the force. The logged seat compliance (0.0009 mm/N) is void after the 5 November pad change, and GB-25 was still at the lab. Robot time ran out before a seat-cup compliance run, so the series correction was not measured on the stand. Reconciling k_fit with the station reference for S-26 gives c_seat ≈ 0.0067 mm/N on the new pad and a corrected rate of 13.95 N/mm (1/k = 1/k_fit − c_seat). All three exam checks were consumed after the time lock and did not return a pass/fail.
